[[File:Cell_2187.png|thumb|250px|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] in Cell 2187]]
{{Quote|We gotta find out which cell this princess of yours is in. Here it is. 2187.|Han Solo to Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Episode IV">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
'''Cell 2187''' was a detention cell located in [[Detention Block AA-23/Legends|Detention Block AA-23]] aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]]. Just prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], it was used for the interrogation and detainment of [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]. She was scheduled for execution before [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] came to [[Rescue of Princess Leia/Legends|rescue]] her.<ref name="Episode IV" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|novelization]] and comic adaptation, Luke Skywalker chooses a different method of entering Cell 2187: He destroys its door with a [[laser pistol]] instead of pressing a button to open it.<ref name="Star Wars: A New Hope novelization">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars: A New Hope'' novelization]]</ref><ref name="Star Wars 1977 3">[[Star Wars (1977) 3|''Star Wars'' (1977) 3]]</ref>

''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]'' erroneously gives this cell's number as "3187."<ref name="Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]''</ref> This error was repeated in [[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Complete Locations'']] and ''[[The Rise and Fall of Darth Vader]]''.<ref name="Star Wars: Complete Locations 2005">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref><ref name="The Rise and Fall of Darth Vader">''[[The Rise and Fall of Darth Vader]]''</ref>

"Cell 2187" is a reference to the short film [[Wikipedia:21-87|''21-87'']], directed by [[Wikipedia:Arthur Lipsett|Arthur Lipsett]]. It reportedly inspired [[George Lucas]] to make the film ''[[Wikipedia:THX-1138|THX-113]]''.<ref name="SWTwitter">{{Twitter|starwars|status/1248749462773612545|''[[Star Wars]]''|date=2020-04-11|quote=Finn's stormtrooper number was FN-2187. The # is a homage to cell 2187 located in detention block AA-23 on the Death Star, the cell of Princess Leia in A New Hope. Cell 2187 from ANH is a ref. to "21-87" a National Film Board of Canada short that inspired a young George Lucas.|archivedate=20210504201436}}</ref>

In the game ''[[Star Wars: Republic Commando]]'', during the ''[[Prosecutor]]'' stage, Commando [[Scorch/Legends|Scorch]] is taken to the ship's detention block, which resembles that of the Death Star's, and is held in [[Cell 2187 (Prosecutor)|cell 2187]].<ref name="Star Wars: Republic Commando">''[[Star Wars: Republic Commando]]''</ref>
